name: Aiko Mori
description: Your parent worries about the risks of shinobi life but wants to see you thrive.
memories: They remember the day you first talked about the academy.
reaction: They trust you and are willing to rely on you.

name: Ren Akiyama
description: A quick, competitive student who respects effort more than boasting.
memories: You have seen each other around the academy, but hardly know one another.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Instructor Daichi
description: A patient instructor who gives useful advice when a student shows consistent effort.
memories: They recognize your name from the academy roster.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Tetsu the Smith
description: A careful village smith who judges a tool by how it holds up under real use.
memories: The village smith has seen every kind of rushed repair.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
description: A loud academy student who refuses to give up on being acknowledged.
memories: The class knows Naruto as the student who turns every quiet lesson into an opportunity to be noticed.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Sasuke Uchiha
description: A talented, distant student carrying the weight of his clan's loss.
memories: Sasuke keeps to himself and rarely speaks unless there is a reason.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Sakura Haruno
description: A sharp student who studies hard and notices more than she lets on.
memories: Sakura is often comparing notes or asking precise questions after class.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Hinata Hyuga
description: A quiet Hyuga student working to find confidence in her own way.
memories: Hinata watches the others carefully and speaks softly when she feels safe.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Shikamaru Nara
description: A strategic thinker who would rather watch a situation than rush into it.
memories: Shikamaru notices patterns quickly, though he rarely volunteers to make extra work for himself.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Iruka Umino
description: An academy instructor who takes his students' futures personally.
memories: Iruka believes steady effort can change the course of a student's life.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Mika Tanaka
description: A mission-desk clerk who matches assignments to readiness and village needs.
memories: They have not yet had a reason to remember you.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Shizune
description: A skilled medic who expects people to take recovery and field safety seriously.
memories: Shizune is careful about who she trusts with medical work.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
description: The village leader balances the needs of its clans, civilians, and shinobi.
memories: He has heard many young shinobi make promises about the future.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Kenta Mori
description: A steady training partner who prefers clean technique over showy wins.
memories: Kenta has offered to spar when you feel ready.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.

name: Kakashi Hatake
description: A renowned jonin whose lessons emphasize teamwork, awareness, and learning from failure.
memories: Kakashi has not yet worked with you directly.
reaction: They are still getting to know you.
